scope: one bounded historical positive-control replay after acknowledged FPGA chip-0 selection; no reset or JTAG

steps.pre_occupancy: same three tmux sessions as prior check, eth and huh attached; no active loader/reset/programming process
steps.positive_control: exact historical OPU-direct ELF with uncredited --no-reset loader; load complete; boot-address write ACK; 0x1000 readback None; bounded termination before MSIP/FESVR
steps.post_occupancy: tmux unchanged; no active loader/reset/programming process

load_rate_note: The 10,650-byte .text section reported 1.53 MB/s in August and 13.2 KB/s in this run. Both used the same uncredited 1,400-byte stop-and-wait loader and no ACK timeout/retry was logged; with only about eight packets, this rate difference cannot establish chip-side or FPGA-to-chip latency. FPGA ACK denotes packet receipt, not downstream completion.
limitations: The chip-selection ACK confirms FPGA control receipt, not the board switch state or chip response.
No direct measurement of chip power, reset pin, clock, or wiring.
The configured bitstream was SHA-matched on disk; FPGA configuration was not read back during this no-JTAG test.
